title: Chicken Salad Avocado
description: Chicken and avocado salad with plenty of veggies is tossed in a homemade vinaigrette for a refreshing salad for lunch or dinner.
ingredients: 4 cups green leafy lettuce, or to taste
1.5 cups thinly sliced cooked chicken breast
0.5 cup thinly sliced green bell pepper
0.5 cup thinly sliced red bell pepper
0.125 teaspoon chopped garlic, or more to taste
1 avocado - peeled, pitted, and thinly sliced

steps.text: Combine lettuce, chicken, black olives, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, and red onion together in a bowl; cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes.
Mix oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, salt, pepper, and garlic in a container with lid; cover and shake until well combined. Refrigerate until chilled, about 30 minutes.
Mix avocado into salad. Shake dressing and drizzle over salad; toss lightly.
